summary: Third slice of the browser-surface generalization (comms-30 / release-22): external-link handoff policy and autofill eligibility as pure-JVM classes in plugins/plugin-native-browser-surface. BrowserExternalLinkPolicy decides mailto (SENDTO), tel (DIAL, never a call), market (VIEW) and intent: (VIEW only; other actions, forbidden data schemes, the host's own schemes and package refused) handoffs for tapped links only, and validates https browser_fallback_url values. BrowserAutofillEligibility states when a tab may take part in the platform autofill framework (selected, shown, running, committed, finished https document without error, engine URL equal to the recorded document) and that only a page-initiated main-frame navigation of an eligible tab commits the session; every other end cancels and pause keeps it.

contract.BrowserExternalLinkPolicy: external(raw) for mailto/tel/intent/market (scheme syntax checked, case-insensitive). decide(raw, userGesture, intentAction, intentDataScheme, intentPackage, ownPackage, hostSchemes) -> SEND_TO | DIAL | VIEW | REFUSE; no gesture, > 4096 chars or control characters refuse; intent: allows only a null or VIEW action, refuses data schemes file/content/javascript/data/blob/about/intent/android-app/empty and the host's own schemes, and the host's own package. fallback(value): https, host, no user info, no whitespace/control, else null.
contract.BrowserAutofillEligibility: eligible(TabState) false when paused, closed, overlay, not selected, not shown, uncommitted, loading, load error, non-https document or engine URL different from the document URL. end(reason, wasEligible): COMMIT only for PAGE_MAIN_FRAME_NAVIGATION of an eligible tab; CANCEL for user-entered address, tab switch, overlay, load error, renderer gone, close; null (keep) for PAUSE.

hostKeeps: Parsing intent: URIs with the platform parser, building a fresh implicit Intent (no page component, selector, clip data, flags or extras; browsable category for VIEW), refusing a resolved target in its own package, the not-handled notice and loading the fallback; the AutofillManager calls (exclusion, notifyViewExited/visibility, cancel/commit), the committed-origin structure and the download review UI, which stays host UI.
notIncluded: Download review UI is not moved: its wording and dialogs are host chrome; its policy is in 0062. Generic profile tab views (WebView profile creation/deletion) stay host code because they depend on androidx.webkit ProfileStore; 0063 holds the persistence policy.
applicationModel: Reference only (not materialized into .eliza/patched). Adds new files only; applies after 0038, 0060, 0062 and 0063 in series (also on a clean base). Alpha's BrowserExternalLinks and AlphaBrowserPlugin.canAutofill keep their equivalent logic until this lands upstream and Alpha consumes the module.
